query:
SELECT m.id, m.sponsorId, m.attendeeId, m.timeSlot, m.attendeeNumber, m.matchScore,
       s.companyName
FROM meetings m
JOIN sponsors s ON s.id = m.sponsorId
WHERE m.attendeeId = '18336501'
ORDER BY m.timeSlot;
